Action: Migrate from static IAM user keys to short-lived AWS Identity Center temporary federated sessions, then disable and delete static keys
Dependency_Check: Verify local MacBook CLI profiles are populated with sso configurations
Backup_or_Recovery_Need: Ensure access to the web console via browser session MFA remains active before deactivating key strings
Implementation_Steps: 1. Run aws configure sso to establish the velora-audit profile. 2. Verify temporary credentials function. 3. Delete old static keys in IAM console.
Rollback_Plan: Temporarily re-generate static keys for a 24-hour troubleshooting window if federation fails
Retest_Command_or_Method: aws iam get-credential-report check confirming active key flags are empty or false
Notes: Secures active human access while avoiding administrative lockout loops

Action: Design and deploy one multi-region CloudTrail trail with log file integrity validation enabled and global service events logging active
Dependency_Check: Ensure no regional trails are currently delivering duplicate logs to prevent cost inflation
Cost_Impact: Log delivery for the first copy of management events is free; standard storage data fees apply to target S3 bucket
Backup_or_Recovery_Need: None; additive configuration that introduces zero modification risks to running compute applications
Implementation_Steps: 1. Run aws cloudtrail create-trail with multi-region flags. 2. Execute aws cloudtrail start-logging.
Rollback_Plan: Execute aws cloudtrail stop-logging via the CLI to instantly pause the log collection stream
Retest_Command_or_Method: aws cloudtrail describe-trails checking for IsMultiRegionTrail and LogFileValidationEnabled matching true
Notes: Preserves critical forensic auditing data before executing deep permission or asset modifications

Action: Implement priority high-risk event detection monitoring rules within Hosted Splunk and establish a daily manual log review procedure
Dependency_Check: Verify CloudTrail event log delivery pipelines are running smoothly
Cost_Impact: Variable data-volume ingestion fees inside the SIEM dashboard
Backup_or_Recovery_Need: Nessus or manual alert tracking rules can be backed up via configuration scripts
Implementation_Steps: 1. Inject metric filter selectors inside log aggregation systems. 2. Bind critical P1 alerts to the security lead distribution channel.
Rollback_Plan: Disable or pause alert monitoring rules inside the SIEM console wrapper if false positive storms occur
Retest_Command_or_Method: Trigger an authorized read-only policy check and verify a high-risk management event notification lands inside SLA thresholds
Notes: Ensures immediate visibility into unauthorized control plane alterations

Action: Deploy an account-level External-Access Analyzer within the primary operating region to continuously scan resource policies
Dependency_Check: Passive read-only check; introduces zero network performance drops or application dependencies
Cost_Impact: Standard External-Access analysis is included at zero extra cost within the AWS Free Tier
Backup_or_Recovery_Need: Nessus or configuration backups are not required
Implementation_Steps: 1. Execute aws accessanalyzer create-analyzer specifying type as ACCOUNT. 2. Verify analyzer registers as active.
Rollback_Plan: Run aws accessanalyzer delete-analyzer to instantly pull down the scanning resource
Retest_Command_or_Method: aws accessanalyzer list-analyzers checking for status matching ACTIVE
Notes: Provides real-time visibility into accidental public or cross-account resource exposure leaks
